task.title: How to create a Gmail account?
task.shortdesc: This procedure will help you create a Gmail account.

step.cmd: From your device, go to the Google Account sign in page.
In the drop down, select if the account is for your: personal use, child, work or business
To set up your account, follow the steps on the screen.

info.note: To use Gmail for your business, a Google Workspace account might be better for you than a personal Google Account. With Google Workspace, you get increased storage, professional email addresses, and additional features. Learn about Google Workspace pricing and plans.
